name: Baked Salmon
description: Oven-baked salmon with olive oil, lemon, garlic and herbs.

steps.description:
Preheat

Preheat the oven to 200°C. Line a baking tray with parchment.

Season

Place the salmon on the tray. Drizzle with olive oil, scatter garlic, season with salt and pepper, and top with lemon and butter if using.

Bake

Bake 12–15 minutes until the salmon flakes easily. Finish with parsley and serve.

name: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Simple banana and oat pancakes, naturally sweet and quick to make.

steps.description:
Blend the batter

Mash the bananas and mix with oats, eggs, baking powder, salt, vanilla and a splash of milk until combined. Rest 5 minutes so the oats soften.

Cook

Heat a lightly greased pan over medium heat. Spoon small pancakes and cook 2–3 minutes per side until golden.

Serve

Serve warm with honey or fresh fruit.

name: Beef Burger
description: Homemade beef burger patties served on bread with fresh toppings.

steps.description:
Make the patties

Mix ground beef, onion, garlic, egg, breadcrumbs, salt and pepper. Shape into 4 patties and chill 10 minutes.

Cook

Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook patties 4–5 minutes per side until cooked through. Add cheese in the last minute if using.

Assemble

Toast the bread lightly. Spread mayonnaise and mustard if using, then add lettuce, tomato and the burger patty. Serve immediately.

name: Chicken Alfredo
description: Creamy Alfredo pasta with pan-seared chicken breast, butter, cream and parmesan.

steps.description:
Season and cook the chicken

Pat the chicken dry, season with salt and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken until golden and cooked through, about 4–5 minutes per side (or until strips are done). Transfer to a plate and slice if needed.

Cook the pasta

Boil the pasta in salted water until al dente. Reserve about 1 cup of pasta water, then drain.

Start the Alfredo sauce

In the same skillet, melt the butter over medium-low heat. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds without browning.

Add cream and cheese

Pour in the cream and simmer 2–3 minutes. Stir in the parmesan until smooth. Loosen with pasta water if the sauce is too thick. Season to taste.

Combine

Toss the pasta in the sauce, then fold in the chicken. Warm through for 1 minute.

Serve

Plate immediately, topped with extra parmesan, black pepper and parsley if using.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
description: Crisp lettuce salad with grilled chicken, parmesan, homemade Caesar-style dressing and crunchy breadcrumbs.

steps.description:
Cook the chicken

Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook until golden and cooked through, about 5–6 minutes per side. Rest a few minutes, then slice.

Make the dressing

In a bowl, whisk mayonnaise, mustard, lemon juice, garlic and the remaining olive oil. Season with salt and black pepper. Thin with a teaspoon of water if needed.

Toast the crumbs

In a dry pan over medium heat, toast the breadcrumbs until golden and crisp, 2–3 minutes. Set aside.

Assemble

Toss the lettuce with most of the dressing. Top with sliced chicken, parmesan, toasted breadcrumbs and the remaining dressing. Serve immediately.

name: Chicken Curry
description: Mild coconut chicken curry with onion, tomato, yogurt and warm spices, served with rice.

steps.description:
Prep

Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and season lightly with salt and black pepper. Chop the onion and tomato; mince the garlic and grate the ginger.

Brown the chicken

Heat the oil in a wide pot over medium-high heat. Brown the chicken in batches until lightly golden, then transfer to a plate.

Build the base

Lower the heat to medium. Soften the onion 6–8 minutes. Add garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute until fragrant.

Spice and tomato

Stir in curry powder, turmeric, cumin and paprika for 30–60 seconds. Add the tomato and cook until it softens into a thick sauce, about 5 minutes.

Simmer

Return the chicken to the pot. Pour in the coconut milk, bring to a gentle simmer, cover and cook 18–22 minutes until the chicken is tender.

Finish

Off the heat, stir in the yogurt and lemon juice. Taste and adjust salt. Scatter cilantro over the top.

Serve

Cook the rice separately and serve the curry spooned over or beside it.

name: Chickpea Salad
description: Fresh salad of chickpeas with vegetables, lemon and olive oil.

steps.description:
Combine

In a bowl, mix chickpeas, tomato, onion, bell pepper and parsley.

Dress

Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper and cumin. Pour over the salad and toss.

Serve

Serve as is or over lettuce. Best after resting 10 minutes.

name: French Toast
description: Golden bread slices soaked in sweet egg-milk batter and pan-fried in butter.

steps.description:
Make the batter

Whisk eggs, milk, sugar, vanilla and a pinch of salt in a shallow dish.

Soak the bread

Dip each bread slice in the batter for a few seconds per side until coated but not falling apart.

Fry

Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Cook the slices 2–3 minutes per side until golden.

Serve

Serve hot with honey, sugar or fresh fruit.

name: Lentil Stew
description: Hearty stew of lentils with onion, carrot, garlic and olive oil.

steps.description:
Sauté aromatics

Heat olive oil in a pot. Cook onion and carrot until soft, then add garlic, paprika and cumin for 1 minute.

Add lentils

Stir in lentils and tomato if using. Cover with water by about 3 cm.

Simmer

Bring to a boil, then simmer gently 25–35 minutes until lentils are tender. Add water if needed. Season with salt and pepper.

Serve

Adjust seasoning and finish with parsley. Serve hot.

name: Margherita Pizza
description: Classic Neapolitan-style pizza with tomato sauce, mozzarella, fresh basil and olive oil.

steps.description:
Activate the yeast

Dissolve the fresh yeast in the lukewarm water and let it rest for 5 minutes until foamy.

Make the dough

Add the flour, salt and 1 tbsp olive oil. Mix and knead for about 10 minutes until the dough is smooth and elastic.

First rise

Cover and let the dough rise for about 1 hour, or until doubled in size.

Shape the base

Stretch the dough into a round pizza (about 30–32 cm), leaving a slightly thicker edge for the crust. Place on a lightly oiled tray or pizza stone.

Add the sauce

Spread the tomato sauce evenly over the dough. If using garlic, stir it into the sauce first.

Add the cheese

Distribute the mozzarella over the sauce, leaving some gaps so the tomato shows through.

Bake

Bake in a preheated oven at 250°C for 10–12 minutes, until the crust is golden and the cheese is melted and lightly browned.

Finish and serve

Top with fresh basil leaves and a drizzle of the remaining olive oil. Slice and serve immediately.

name: Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
description: Beef meatballs simmered in a simple tomato sauce.

ingredients.preparation: half minced for meatballs, half chopped for sauce

steps.description:
Form the meatballs

Mix beef, egg, breadcrumbs, minced onion, garlic, parsley, salt and pepper. Roll into golf-ball sized meatballs.

Brown

Heat olive oil in a wide pan and brown the meatballs on all sides. Remove to a plate.

Make the sauce

In the same pan, soften the remaining onion, then add tomato sauce, oregano, salt and pepper. Simmer 5 minutes.

Simmer together

Return the meatballs to the sauce. Cover and cook gently 20–25 minutes until cooked through. Finish with basil and parmesan if using.

name: Pancakes
description: Fluffy classic pancakes for breakfast or brunch.

ingredients.preparation: melted, plus more for the pan

steps.description:
Make the batter

Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. In another bowl mix milk, eggs, melted butter and vanilla. Combine wet and dry until just mixed; small lumps are fine.

Cook

Heat a lightly buttered pan over medium heat. Pour batter by the ladle and cook until bubbles form, then flip and cook 1–2 minutes more.

Serve

Stack and serve warm with honey, fruit or sugar.

name: Pasta Alfredo
description: Creamy pasta tossed with butter, cream and parmesan cheese.

steps.description:
Cook the pasta

Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta until al dente. Reserve about 1 cup of pasta water, then drain.

Start the sauce

In a wide pan over medium-low heat, melt the butter. Add the garlic if using and cook for 30 seconds without browning.

Add the cream

Pour in the cream and simmer gently for 2–3 minutes until slightly thickened. Season with salt and black pepper.

Melt the cheese

Lower the heat and stir in the grated parmesan until the sauce is smooth. Loosen with a splash of pasta water if it gets too thick.

Toss and serve

Add the drained pasta to the pan and toss until every strand is coated. Adjust seasoning and serve immediately with extra parmesan if desired.

name: Pizza Muzzarella
description: Classic pizza with tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, oregano and green olives.

steps.description:
Activate the yeast

In a bowl, dissolve the fresh yeast in the lukewarm water and let it rest for 5 minutes.

Prepare the dough

Add the flour, salt and olive oil. Mix until a dough forms and knead for about 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.

First rise

Cover the dough with a clean cloth and let it rise for approximately 1 hour, or until doubled in size.

Shape the pizza

Stretch the dough into a 30–32 cm round pizza and place it on a lightly oiled baking tray or pizza stone.

Add the tomato sauce

Spread the tomato sauce evenly over the dough, leaving a small border for the crust.

Bake

Bake in a preheated oven at 250°C for about 10–12 minutes, until the crust is golden and the cheese is melted.

Finish and serve

Sprinkle the oregano over the pizza, add the green olives, slice and serve immediately.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: Classic Italian meat sauce with spaghetti, simmered tomato, ground beef and aromatics.

steps.description:
Prepare the soffritto

Heat the olive oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Add the onion and carrot and cook for 5–7 minutes until soft. Stir in the garlic for 1 minute.

Brown the meat

Add the ground beef, break it up with a spoon, and cook until no longer pink and lightly browned.

Build the sauce

Stir in the tomato sauce and diced tomato if using. Season with salt, black pepper and oregano. Bring to a gentle simmer.

Simmer

Lower the heat and cook uncovered for 25–35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and the flavors concentrate.

Cook the spaghetti

Meanwhile, boil the spaghetti in salted water according to package directions until al dente. Reserve a small cup of pasta water, then drain.

Combine

Toss the spaghetti with the bolognese sauce, loosening with a splash of pasta water if needed. Tear in basil if using.

Serve

Plate and finish with grated parmesan cheese. Serve immediately.

name: Spanish Omelette
description: Classic Spanish tortilla with eggs, potato and onion, cooked slowly in olive oil.

steps.description:
Cook the potatoes

Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the potato and onion with a pinch of salt. Cook gently, stirring often, until the potatoes are tender but not browned, about 15–20 minutes.

Beat the eggs

In a large bowl, beat the eggs with salt and black pepper. Drain the potatoes and onion (reserve a little oil) and fold them into the eggs. Rest 5 minutes.

Set the omelette

Return a thin layer of oil to the pan over medium heat. Pour in the mixture and cook until the edges set, about 4–5 minutes.

Flip and finish

Flip with a plate and cook the other side 3–4 minutes until just set in the center. Rest briefly, slice and serve warm or at room temperature.
